title.zh: 将宿务省第二座曼达维—马克坦大桥命名为马塞洛·B·费尔南大桥的法案
title.en: An Act Naming the 2nd Mandaue-Mactan Bridge in the Province of Cebu as the Marcelo B. Fernan Bridge
title.orig: An Act Naming the 2nd Mandaue-Mactan Bridge in the Province of Cebu as the Marcelo B. Fernan Bridge

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2000/ra_8795_2000.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The 2nd Mandaue-Mactan Bridge situated in the Province of Cebu is hereby named as the Marcelo B. Fernan Bridge.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
